name: Jeffrey A. Baskies
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Boca Raton, Florida
about: Jeffrey A. Baskies, Esq. is a graduate of Trinity College (with highest honors) and Harvard Law School (with honors). Jeff is a co-founding partner of Katz Baskies LLC, concentrating on trusts and estates, tax, and business law. Jeff is Board Certified by The Florida Bar as an expert in Wills, Trusts and Estates, is AV preeminent rated by Martindale-Hubbell, has been voted to the Top 100 list in Florida Super Lawyers, 2009-2015, was voted to the Top 10 list in Florida Super Lawyers, 2014, and is included in The Best Lawyers in America (he was the 2013 trusts and estates Lawyer of the Year for south Florida). Jeff has published more than 100 articles on estate planning and is the successor author of the treatise Estate, Gift, Trust, and Fiduciary Tax Returns: Planning and Preparation (2013-2016) published by Thomson Reuters/West.
3020 N. Military Trail Suite 100 Boca Raton, FL 33431
